question: If 4(z + 7) (2z – 1) = Az² + Bz + C, then the value of A + B + C is:
solution:
**Given:**

If 4(z + 7) (2z – 1) = Az2 + Bz + C

**Calculation:**

⇒ 4(z + 7) (2z – 1) = Az2 + Bz + C

⇒ 4(2z² - z + 14z - 7) = Az2 + Bz + C

⇒ 8z² - 4z + 56z - 28 = Az2 + Bz + C

⇒ 8z² + 52z - 28 = Az2 + Bz + C

Comparing RHS and LHS: 

A = 8, B = 52 and C = - 28

⇒ A + B + C = 8 + 52 - 28 

⇒ A + B + C = 32

∴ T**he value of A + B + C is 32.**
